new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors (CLH) Earnings Expected to Grow: What to Know Ahead of Next Week's Release
new_today_news.summary: Consensus estimates call for Clean Harbors Q2 2026 earnings of $2.73 per share, representing 15.7% year-over-year growth. The company has a history of outperforming estimates, with an Earnings ESP of +3.82%.

recent_news.headline: Airbus unveils study on the potential of sustainable aviation fuel to support economic growth and accelerate Canada's climate transition
recent_news.summary: Airbus study projects a Canadian SAF market could generate $32B GDP and 140,000 jobs by 2040. Development of the value chain between 2026-2040 would create significant economic benefits.

recent_news.headline: High feedstock costs slow the development of Europe's sustainable aviation fuel market
recent_news.summary: Europe's SAF market faced sharp increases in production costs during H1 2026, driven primarily by rising used cooking oil (UCO) feedstock prices, volatile energy markets, and capacity concerns. The article highlights structural feedstock constraints limiting SAF supply.

recent_news.headline: Sample New Restaurant Openings from RestaurantData: Blood Bros BBQ, Alexas Cafe, 77 Flavors Wings Expanding
recent_news.summary: Blood Bros BBQ opens second location at Houston airport; Alexas Cafe debuts third location in Riverside, CA; 77 Flavors Wings & Philly opens eighth restaurant in Stockbridge, Georgia. Multi-unit concepts continue regional expansion.

backfill_news.headline: Waste data becoming the next greatest test of ESG credibility
backfill_news.summary: Stakeholders now expect waste data to be reported with the same rigor as financial information. Waste has become a strategic ESG factor that investors and financial institutions are scrutinizing closely, with expectations shifting from large corporates to smaller businesses.

backfill_news.headline: St. Louis Restaurant Openings and Closings: BJ's Bar & Restaurant Closes After 70 Years
backfill_news.summary: BJ's Bar & Restaurant, a 70-year-old St. Louis institution, closed in July. The Noble Crown opened in Central West End; Del Bono pizzeria and Chico Bueno also launched. Sonic The Hedgehog Speed Café pop-up extended at Nudo House.
